acquisition_method.evidence: Data was collected by MS/MS using a HF-X Orbitrap system in DIA mode.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: After drying, VAMS were washed in LiCl and Tris, then reduced and alkylated with a solution containing SDC, TCEP, chloroacetamide and TEAB.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested with trypsin and resulting peptides were separated on a nanoLC column (75µm x 50cm) over 62.5 minute gradient.
